bounded_tile_recheck.purpose: Rule out a stale tile heuristic before changing device code; all variants are byte-exact against 16x16.

selected_candidate.design: Two-wave 64-column block whose waves preserve the proven 32x32 WMMA order while sharing one BF16-to-FP16 activation tile through bounded LDS.
selected_candidate.hypothesis: The dominant 32x32 body is the tile winner but uses 104 VGPR and two independent blocks reload/reconvert the same activation tile. Pairing two unchanged 32-column waves can retain per-wave accumulator pressure while amortizing activation loads/conversions across 64 columns, avoiding the 112-VGPR one-wave 64x32 schedule.
selected_candidate.first_gate: Add a callable diagnostic wrapper; require byte-exact output vs 32x32 on BF16 fixtures, no scratch, plausible 64-thread/two-wave profiler geometry, and a paired real-shape micro win before any full-model route.
